YOUR JOURNAL, YOUR DEVICE

Settings & backup

App updates

App version 4 · Automatic updates on

Updates check when you open or return to the app, and while it stays open online. Your trails, delivery keys and settings stay on this device. Updates wait until you close open forms.

Take your journal with you

Export an encrypted backup, then import it on your new phone. Keep your password somewhere safe. Your GitHub token is excluded.

GitHub delivery inbox

New entries are encrypted for this device. The service worker saves them locally, then deletes the active inbox files. Encrypted copies can remain in Git history. Imports run on opening, reconnecting, or “Check deliveries”; background runs depend on your browser.

The token stays in this browser’s local database. Enter it here, never in chat. Anyone with device/browser access may access local data.

Connect this device automatically publishes its public key to GitHub. The export button is available for manual setup. Never upload a backup or private key. See repository README for the entry hook.

Install on iPhone

Open this app in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. On Mac, use Safari → File → Add to Dock.

Local reviews aren’t uploaded. Clearing site data or removing the app may erase them. Back up regularly. Online maps send tile requests to OpenStreetMap; directions open Apple Maps.
